changelog:
v3.9.0 — Smoother Playback + Phone Overhaul + Actor Search

PLAYBACK
• Poster art now shows while a movie, show, or channel loads — no more black screen with a lone spinner.
• Fewer loading spinners on quick buffers, and faster, quieter recovery when a stream hiccups.
• Resume is more reliable — your spot is no longer lost if a stream rebuffers as you exit.
• Channel changes start fresh at full quality; binge episodes no longer lose audio; captions only turn on when the show actually has them.

SEARCH
• Search by actor — type a star's name to find their movies and shows.

HOME
• The hero banner now has a clear ▶ Play button for the featured movie, with More Info for details.

PHONE / TABLET
• Major touch overhaul: smoother scrolling, full-width Settings, and fixed Live TV, Login, Account, and detail screens on phones.
